content.what_it_is: MATLAB script (OSU runup benchmark, BM2) comparing modeled U and V velocity components against ADV station C measurements in two panels. Same skeleton as plot_ADV_AB.m: sk=2, fact=1 (L3-4), figure setup (L6); time alignment via peak match between model FSE_BM2_shi_tvd.txt eta column 1 (L8-22) and measured WG1.txt column 2 (L24-30), t=t-num_t_shift+exp_t_shift without the -0.25 correction (L32). Panel 211 (U): loads VT_C_BM2_shi_tvd.txt into padded vel (L35-39) and measured U_Velocity_AverageC.txt (L40), plots measured (subsampled, demeaned by first 25 samples, L43) vs model vel(:,1) (L46), axis [0 47 -2.0 3.5] (L49). Panel 212 (V): reloads VT_C, loads V_Velocity_AverageC.txt (L51-56), 'ADV C' text (L57) and legend (L59) issued before subplot(212) (L61); plots measured V (L63) vs model vel(:,2) (L67; comment L66 'here measurement has 0.25 lag'), ylabel 'V (m/s)' (L69), axis (L71), xlabel (L72). No writes.
entities: script variables: sk @L3, fact @L4, datae @L8, m,n @L10, t @L11, eta @L12, WGdata @L14, num_shift_ind @L18, num_t_shift @L19, exp_shift_ind @L26, exp_t_shift @L27, data @L35/L51, nn @L36/L52, n=6 @L37/L53, vel @L38-39/L54-55, veldata @L40/L56

equations.expr: t=t-num_t_shift+exp_t_shift; % some difference between eta and u

equations.ref: velocity columns into padded array (also L55)

calls: clf @L1; clear all @L2; set(gcf,...) @L6; load @L8, @L14, @L35, @L40, @L51, @L56; size @L10, @L36, @L52; max @L17, @L25; zeros @L38, @L54; subplot @L42, @L61; plot @L43, @L46, @L63, @L67; hold on @L45, @L65; ylabel @L47, @L69; grid @L48, @L68; axis @L49, @L71; text @L57, @L70; legend @L59; xlabel @L72

verbatim_spans.text: t=t-num_t_shift+exp_t_shift; % some difference between eta and u

unresolved: Comment L66 notes the measurement has a 0.25 s lag but no shift is applied to either curve in this script (unlike the -0.25 in plot_ADV_AB.m L32) -- relation L32 vs L66.
text('ADV C') and legend at L57/L59 execute after the V-station data replace veldata but before subplot(212); both land on the first axes.
n=6 (L37, L53) overwrites the size() column count; num_shift_ind/exp_shift_ind unused; vel padded to 6 columns with only columns 1-2 plotted; VT file column layout undocumented here.
